items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had to audition on clarinet... Imitates playing Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Eine Kleine Nachtmusick Movt. 1

ctx.x: Ok? And So Halsey Stevens saw that - cause when I auditioned for the symphony band - symphonic orchestra - I had to audition on clarinet. Well all those little boys who had auditioned before me they said: [Imitates playing Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Eine Kleine Nachtmusick Movt. 1]. So I said, “damn, all these motherfuckers sound alike!”
